description: Provision a Google Cloud Networksecurity NetworkSecurityClientTLSPolicy via Config Connector. Fields mirror the networksecurity.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 NetworkSecurityClientTLSPolicy spec.

clientCertificate.description: Optional. Defines a mechanism to provision client identity (public and private keys) for peer to peer authentication. The presence of this dictates mTLS.

certificateProviderInstance.description: Optional. The certificate provider instance specification that will be passed to the data plane, which will be used to load necessary credential information.

pluginInstance.description: Required. Plugin instance name, used to locate and load CertificateProvider instance configuration. Set to "google_cloud_private_spiffe" to use Certificate Authority Service certificate provider instance.

grpcEndpoint.description: Optional. gRPC specific configuration to access the gRPC server to obtain the cert and private key.

targetUri.description: Required. The target URI of the gRPC endpoint. Only UDS path is supported, and should start with "unix:".

description.description: Optional. Free-text description of the resource.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

kind.description: The kind of the Project resource; optional but must be `Project` if provided.

resourceID.description: The NetworkSecurityClientTLSPolicy name. If not given, the metadata.name will be used.

serverValidationCa.description: Optional. Defines the mechanism to obtain the Certificate Authority certificate to validate the server certificate. If empty, client does not validate the server certificate.

certificateProviderInstance.description: Optional. The certificate provider instance specification that will be passed to the data plane, which will be used to load necessary credential information.

pluginInstance.description: Required. Plugin instance name, used to locate and load CertificateProvider instance configuration. Set to "google_cloud_private_spiffe" to use Certificate Authority Service certificate provider instance.

grpcEndpoint.description: Optional. gRPC specific configuration to access the gRPC server to obtain the CA certificate.

targetUri.description: Required. The target URI of the gRPC endpoint. Only UDS path is supported, and should start with "unix:".

sni.description: Optional. Server Name Indication string to present to the server during TLS handshake. E.g: "secure.example.com".

title: GCP Networksecurity NetworkSecurityClientTLSPolicy
